outcome: Organ weights (adrenal gland, bone mineral content)
Hematology (total leucocyte levels, neutrophil, monocyte, eosinophil counts, helper T cell fractions)
cohort: The study participants were preterm pigs delivered by cesarean section and fed bovine milk diets.
finding: Moderate fetal and postnatal growth restriction in preterm pigs had limited effects on systemic immune development, despite some marginal effects on immune cell populations, adrenocortical function, and body composition.
birth_weight: Fetal growth restricted pigs were defined as the lowest 25% of birth weight, excluding those with birth weight <350g.
